chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, from Zurārah, from one of them, peace be upon them.
Concerning a man who forced a woman against herself.
He said: “He is to be killed.”

key_terms.أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ: one of the two Imams, peace be upon them
key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman, the victim mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.نَفْسَهَا: herself; indicating coercion against her person
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: he is to be killed; the stated legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām on a man who forces a woman sexually?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who forcibly violates a woman. The Imam عليه السلام states that the punishment for such an act is death, indicating the gravity of sexual coercion in Islamic jurisprudence.
